questions.question:
6 girls J, K, L, A, B and C are sitting around a square table facing the centre (not necessarily in the same order). 4 girls are sitting in the corners and 2 girls are sitting one each in the middle of two opposite sides of the square. L and C are sitting opposite each other. L is the immediate neighbour of A and B. C is not sitting on the corner.

Who are the immediate neighbours of C?
questions.solution:
Given: 6 girls J, K, L, A, B and C.

4 girls are sitting in the corners and 2 girls are sitting one each in the middle of two opposite sides of the square.

1. C is not sitting on the corner.

2. L and C are sitting opposite each other.

questions.question:
Two statements are given, followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements**:

All Books are Pens.

All Pens are Pencils.

**Conclusions:**

I. All Books are Pencils.

II. All Pencils are Books.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow.
Neither conclusion I nor II follows.

questions.solution:
Statement:

All Books are Pens.

All Pens are Pencils.

The least possible diagram for the given statements is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d3c07d0abe86079d9105f752db987406c37180305bb6b4ec7651f94ef80be9f8.png] 

Conclusions:

(i) All Books are Pencils - **True** (Because All Books are Pens and All Pens are Pencils, so All Books are Pencil also).

(ii) All Pencils are Books - False (All Pencils are Books can be possible not definitely).

Here, Only conclusion I follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **"**Option 3".

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statement I: **Some teeth are noses and some noses are hands.

**Statement II:** Some hands are feet.

**Conclusion I:** Some teeth are feet.

**Conclusion II:** All hands are noses.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow.
Neither conclusion I nor II follow.

questions.solution:
Statement:

I: Some teeth are noses and some noses are hands.

II: Some hands are feet.

The least possible diagram for the given statements is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eca58007d900b65b910c9fca85ef04a8534e30961a7e3dc86feedb2b786aaf61.png] 

Conclusions:

(i) Some teeth are feet - False (Because there is no direct relation between 'teeth' and 'feet', so it is possible but not definite)

(ii) All hands are noses - False** **(Some nose are hands, But all hands are nose can be possible not definite)

Here, Neither conclusion I nor II follow.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".

questions.question: No two of the six friends U, V, W, X, Y and Z, are of the same height. V is taller than only three other friends. Z is only taller than X. W is shorter than U only. Find who is the third shortest among all the friends.
questions.solution:
Given: Six friends U, V, W, X, Y and Z.

V is taller than only three other friends. 

_ > _ > V > _ > _ > _

Z is only taller than X (This means X is the smallest and Z is the second smallest).

_ > _ > V > _ > Z > X

W is shorter than U only (This means U is the tallest and W is the second tallest).

U > W > V > _ > Z > X

And, Y will be sit at the remaining place.

U > W > V > Y > Z > X

So, Y is the third shortest among all the friends.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Y"**.

questions.question:
Which two numbers (not digits) need to be interchanged to make the given equation correct?

10 × 18 + 216 ÷ 5 – 41 = 21

What will come in the place of ‘?’ in the following equation, if ‘+’ and ‘–‘ are interchanged and also ‘×’ and ‘÷’ are interchanged?

20 × 5 − 10 + 5 ÷ 2 = ?
questions.solution:
BODMAS Table: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d50192f098c21078501d30eeafe1a8c64bc30dd9621c48caa8a39ffc60f68b64.png] 

Given equation: 20 × 5 − 10 + 5 ÷ 2 = ? 

Now, if ‘+’ and ‘–‘ and ‘×’ and ‘÷’ are interchanged, then:

⇒ **__20 ÷ 5__** + 10 - 5 × 2 = ? 

⇒ 4 + 10 - __**5 × 2**__ 

⇒ __**4 + 10**__ - 10

⇒ __**14 - 10**__ = 4.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**.
